concepts.title: Suppression of large support scores
concepts.description:
If successful overlaps vanish, then for any positive score threshold and error
tolerance there are bounded common linear coordinates on which the probability of an
eligible generic option above threshold is small. The coordinates are chosen before
filters that can depend on both leaves.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax793645.ConstructionData

/-!
---
title: Suppression of large support scores
type: lemma
---
If successful overlaps vanish, then for any positive score threshold and error
tolerance there are bounded common linear coordinates on which the probability of an
eligible generic option above threshold is small. The coordinates are chosen before
filters that can depend on both leaves.
-/

namespace Lax793645.SupportScores

section

  {m:cycleM p} {s:OneRhythms p M} {w:OneTale p M}

axiom one_generic_lightmap (v:OneStations p M (onePreparationPins q) s)
    (h:OneVeil p M q s0 l m s w) (a ε τ:ℝ) (ha:0< a) (he:0<ε) (hτ:0<τ)
    (L R:ℕ) (Y:∀ n,OneSilhouette p (M* n) L)
    (hY:∀ n,OneFullLinearSilhouette (Y n) R):
    ∃ r coords:ℕ,∃ δ:ℝ,∀ᶠ n in l,
      ∃ X:OneSilhouette p (M* n) r,OneRefines X (Y n) ∧ OneFullLinearSilhouette X coords ∧
        OneGenericBeams (m n) X (s n) (w n) (v n) a ε δ τ

end

end Lax793645.SupportScores

concepts.title: Three holes cannot form a triangle
concepts.description:
The hole relation is symmetric and irreflexive. Evaluating its six functional
identities around a triangle cancels the ambient evaluations and the symmetric
bilinear terms. The three remaining role parities sum to one.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax793645.Holes

/-!
---
title: Three holes cannot form a triangle
type: lemma
---
The hole relation is symmetric and irreflexive. Evaluating its six functional
identities around a triangle cancels the ambient evaluations and the symmetric
bilinear terms. The three remaining role parities sum to one.
-/

namespace Lax793645.TriangleFreeHoles

/-- Injectivity rules out loops. Symmetry of the pairing rules out triangles. -/
axiom triangle_free {I X V : Type*} (U : I → X → V) (u : I → V → ZMod 2)
    (a : X → ZMod 2) (T : X → X → ZMod 2)
    (injective : ∀ i, Function.Injective (U i)) (symm : ∀ x y, T x y = T y x) :
    let H := Holes.relation U u a T
    (∀ i j, H i j → H j i) ∧ (∀ i, ¬H i i) ∧
      ∀ i j k, H i j → H j k → ¬H i k

section

open Lax793645.ConstructionData.Frames
open Lax793645.ConstructionData.Binary.HadwigerCounterexample
open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators

variable {p : Shape} {n N : ℕ}

axiom one_hole_sym {m : Mixer p n} {x y : OneOrient p n N}
    (h : Holes.hole m x y) : Holes.hole m y x

end

end

section
open Lax793645.ConstructionData.Binary
open Lax793645.ConstructionData.Frames
open Lax793645.ConstructionData.Binary.HadwigerCounterexample
open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
variable {p : Shape} {n N : ℕ}

axiom one_hole_triangle {m : Mixer p n} {x y z : OneOrient p n N}

end

end Lax793645.TriangleFreeHoles

triangle_free : ∀ {I : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} (U : I → X → V) (u : I → V → ZMod 2) (a : X → ZMod 2)
  (T : X → X → ZMod 2),
  (∀ (i : I), Function.Injective (U i)) →
    (∀ (x y : X), Eq (T x y) (T y x)) →
      let H := Lax793645.Holes.relation U u a T;

concepts.title: Overlap without common predictions
concepts.description:
If all accepted overlaps were small, the support comparison would suppress every
option. In the branch without common predictions, soluble scalar lists on a positive
mass of pairs contradict that suppression.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax793645.ConstructionData

/-!
---
title: Overlap without common predictions
type: lemma
---
If all accepted overlaps were small, the support comparison would suppress every
option. In the branch without common predictions, soluble scalar lists on a positive
mass of pairs contradict that suppression.
-/

namespace Lax793645.UnpredictedOverlap

section
open Lax793645.ConstructionData.Binary
open Lax793645.ConstructionData.Frames

  {m:cycleM p} {s:OneRhythms p M} {w:OneTale p M}

axiom one_quiet_end (v:OneStations p M (onePreparationPins q) s)
    (h:OneVeil p M q s0 l m s w) (hv:∀ᶠ n in l,(v n).bank) (hl:l.NeBot)
    (hout:oneLinearSilenceOutcome q l m w s):False

end

end Lax793645.UnpredictedOverlap

proofs.description:
The complete single-frame quadratic construction produces graphs of arbitrarily large
order. Its touching-matching number is the archive's matching number by
definitional equality, and the strict rational bound gives the integral bound.

Theorem 1.1 supplies the graph. The proved matching-minor bound and
chromatic lower bound then contradict Hadwiger's inequality.
Give each color class of an optimal ordinary coloring unit weight.

Sum the coverage inequalities over vertices, interchange the two finite
sums, and use the bound of two on every independent set.

The proved construction supplies the graph. Apply the matching-minor bound
and the two proved fractional-coloring inequalities.

A graph with independence number at most two needs at least half as many
colors as vertices.

The maximum is attained by an actual clique-minor branch model. This proves
the bound for the literal Hadwiger number, including the empty graph.

Eliminate an ordinary row and its column together. Two affine point
squares suffice to match every entry in that row, including its diagonal.
When only the constant entry remains, the point at zero supplies it.

Sum the two functional evaluations at each of the three vertices. The shared
ambient vectors cancel in pairs. The symmetric terms cancel too, leaving
one copy of each edge parity.
